instruction: Identify and open the general aviation topic in the FlightAware discussions.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to FlightAware discussions and opening the general aviation category. Similar to the original task's navigation pattern but focuses on category rather than specific topic. Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions (get_active_tab_info and is_expected_active_tab) to verify the correct category URL is opened.
metadata.similarity_justification: Same website (FlightAware discussions), same interaction pattern (navigate to discussions, find category/topic, open it), same difficulty level. Only difference is targeting a category instead of a specific topic thread.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_active_tab_info) correctly extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree and retrieves page information
Metric (is_expected_active_tab) correctly compares the actual URL with expected URL using compare_urls function for flexible URL matching
Expected URL (https://discussions.flightaware.com/c/general-aviation/12) is semantically correct for the FlightAware general aviation discussion category
Complete instruction coverage: The instruction requires finding and opening the general aviation discussion topic, which is fully verified by checking that the correct category URL is active
Logical data flow is correct: accessibility tree → extract URL → navigate and get page info → extract URL from result → compare with expected
goto_prefix parameter (https://www.) is correctly configured for get_active_tab_info getter
No postconfig needed as verification only requires checking browser active tab state
